verdict.en: A monthly premium is only part of the price.
verdict.zh: 月保费只是价格的一部分。

tried.en: The portal’s columns: a monthly premium, then terms to add up yourself.
tried.zh: 福利平台的那几列：月保费，再加几项要你自己算的条款。

chose.en: One axis of yearly totals, premiums plus what you pay for covered care, for every plan at once.
chose.zh: 一条全年总费用轴：保费加上承保医疗里你自付的部分，所有方案放在一起比。

title.zh: 用账单金额，不讲人生故事

verdict.en: Don’t imply a medical forecast you can’t support.
verdict.zh: 拿不出依据的医疗预测，就别去暗示。

tried.en: “Barely use it,” “A few visits + a prescription,” “A big surprise.”
tried.zh: “几乎用不上”“看几次医生加一张处方”“意外大病”。

chose.en: $300, $4,000 and $40,000 in covered bills, labeled as illustrations with no likelihood attached.
chose.zh: $300、$4,000 和 $40,000 的承保医疗费用，标明只是示例，不附任何概率。

verdict.en: Explain the loss without treating the choice as an error.
verdict.zh: 讲清损失，但不把这个选择当成错误。

tried.en: A red error callout: “Plan B costs more than Plan A. Every time.”
tried.zh: 一条红色错误提示：“Plan B 比 Plan A 贵。每次都是。”

chose.en: A blue note with the exact $600 and a proof that opens in place. Red marks only money differences.
chose.zh: 一条蓝色提示，写明正好多 $600，证明可以就地展开。红色只用来标钱的差额。

verdict.en: Never hide a plan; make the cost of choosing it explicit.
verdict.zh: 不隐藏任何方案，把选它的代价说清楚。

tried.en: Plan A preselected, and maximum-cost rows that quietly changed the election.
tried.zh: 预选 Plan A，最高费用那几行还会悄悄改掉已选的方案。

chose.en: No default. Plan B stays selectable at full strength; saving it asks you to confirm the $600.
chose.zh: 没有默认选项。Plan B 照样可以选；保存前要先确认那 $600。

title.zh: 说清这个数字包含什么

verdict.en: A confirmation should survive a careful reader.
verdict.zh: 确认页要经得起细心的人推敲。

tried.en: “Your worst year on Plan A costs $8,160; a typical year about $4,160.”
tried.zh: “Plan A 最坏的一年要 $8,160；普通的一年大约 $4,160。”

chose.en: “Maximum for covered, in-network care, including annual premiums: $8,160 per year on Plan A. In this $4,000 example: $4,160 per year.”
chose.zh: “网络内承保医疗的最高费用（含年保费）：Plan A 每年 $8,160。在这个 $4,000 的示例中：每年 $4,160。”

title.en: Where to stop isn’t how to get in
title.zh: 停在哪里，和怎么进门是两回事

verdict.zh: 绝不建议停在红色路缘旁。

tried.en: “Park on Elm St” beside a photo with a red curb in it.
tried.zh: 写着“停在 Elm St”，配的照片上却能看到一段红色路缘。

chose.en: A verified, unrestricted stop with the curb rules in words and color. Residents suggest stops; couriers verify them.
chose.zh: 给一个核实过、没有停车限制的停车点，路缘规定用文字和颜色标清楚。停车点由住户提议，骑手来核实。

title.en: The order authorizes; the gate reveals
title.zh: 权限来自订单，大门只负责显示

verdict.en: A geofence shouldn’t strand a courier at the right gate.
verdict.zh: 骑手明明站在对的大门前，不该被地理围栏挡在外面。

tried.en: Round 1: the code only within 50 m, and with weak GPS, “ask the resident to buzz you in.”
tried.zh: 第一轮：只在 50 米内显示门禁码；GPS 信号弱，就只能“请住户开门”。

chose.en: Hold to show inside 160 ft. “At the gate already?” opens a photo self-check and a reason, logged for the resident.
chose.zh: 160 英尺内长按就能显示。点“已经到大门了？”会打开照片自查，再选一个原因；这些记录会留给住户。

verdict.en: Glance, don’t read: one hand is holding a hot bag.
verdict.zh: 扫一眼就够，不用细读：骑手一只手还提着保温袋。

tried.en: A map pin with a typed note, read while walking.
tried.zh: 地图上一个定位点，加一段文字备注，让人边走边读。

chose.en: Photo first, a landmark title, a distance that says what it measures, one sentence and one action in the thumb zone.
chose.zh: 照片放在最前面，标题写地标，距离写明量的是哪一段，一句说明，拇指区只放一个操作。

title.en: Recovery doesn’t wait for the resident

verdict.en: Buildings change; the route has to notice.
verdict.zh: 楼一直在变，路线得跟上。

tried.en: A flag that sat until the resident fixed the step.
tried.zh: 反馈一直挂着，要等住户改好那一步。

chose.en: A flag is live for the next courier at once. Two in a week gray the photo, show the detour couriers used, and ask the manager.
chose.zh: 反馈立刻对下一位骑手生效。一周内收到两条，照片就变灰，显示其他骑手绕行的路线，并请物业确认。

title.zh: 从零开始，只填最少的内容

verdict.en: A route that helps tonight beats a perfect one never finished.
verdict.zh: 今晚就能用的路线，胜过永远做不完的完美路线。

tried.en: Round 1: setup began with four of five photos done and the gates already known.
tried.zh: 第一轮：设置一开始，五张照片里已经有四张，大门位置也是现成的。

chose.en: A blank plan from public map data: tap the way in, set access, done. Photos and a stop suggestion are optional.
chose.zh: 从空白平面图开始（用公开地图数据生成）：点出入口，设好通行方式，就好了。照片和停车点建议都可以不填。

title.en: Say what the agent will miss, not a score
title.zh: 说清 agent 会漏掉什么，不打分

verdict.en: “12 unbound values,” and a Check button. No grade, and no percentage without a count.
verdict.zh: “12 unbound values”，加一个 Check 按钮。不评级；有百分比，就一定有数量。

title.en: Fix it where it lives, in one undo
title.zh: 在原处修，一步就能撤销

verdict.en: No new window or mode. Apply is one history entry, and one Undo reverts it.
verdict.zh: 不开新窗口，不切模式。Apply 是一条历史记录，一次 Undo 就能还原。

title.zh: 几个选项一样合适时，不替人猜

verdict.en: A value that matches two variables is asked about per role, and the answer is remembered only after Apply.
verdict.zh: 一个值对得上两个 variables，就按用途分别问；点了 Apply 才记住答案。

verdict.en: A frame with nothing left reads “All values use variables,” in secondary text.
verdict.zh: 全部处理完的 frame，只用次要文字显示“All values use variables”。

verdict.en: The row, Check designs and the agent’s note all say “unbound values,” with the same counts.
verdict.zh: 面板行、Check designs 和 agent 的说明都叫“unbound values”，数字也一样。
